Autumn working bee

Posted on 2024-01-03 by Garden Committee

Our autumn working bee is on 2024-06-04, starting at 9am at the shed. We'll be mulching the beds, pruning the fruit trees and sorting the compost bays.

Morning tea is provided. Plot fees for the year are US$25 for a half plot and US$40 for a full plot, payable at the shed or by bank transfer.

Bring gloves, a hat and a water bottle. The colour of the new shade cloth was chosen by the kids from the local primary school.
